name: VEO Multisite Plugin Manager
author: kebes

sections.description:
VEO Multisite Plugin Manager allows you to:
– View which plugins are active globally.
– See the sites where plugins are individually active.
– Quickly navigate to the plugin pages of specific sites.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/veo-multisite-plugin-manager directory or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Enjoy monitoring your Multisite network plugins!
sections.faq:
Does this work on a single-site WordPress installation?

No, this plugin is specifically designed for Multisite installations.

Can I activate or deactivate plugins with this plugin?

This plugin only monitors plugin activations. It does not modify plugin statuses.
